title: Harborview Pension Fund: mid-cap value sleeve, forum registration and a personal aside (live Teams demo call)
shows: Privacy by design: a card number, a personal cell number and a medical detail never reach the note, and the small talk is left out of it.
notes: Played into ONE microphone, so every line is attributed to the host: customer lines make no first-person commitments and nothing says today, tonight or tomorrow. All personal data is fake: 4111 1111 1111 1111 is the standard card test number and 206 555 0188 is a reserved fictional number. Each sensitive item sits in its own line, so dropping it loses no business content: the card (payment_card), the personal cell (personal_contact) and the knee surgery (medical). Alex Kim covering in December is business context and stays. The Seahawks and Seattle chat is small talk: the policy only keeps rapport that the customer says, and a one-microphone recording attributes no line to the customer, so it is left out of the note.

surface_forms: Contoso Mid Cap Value Fund, Class R6

gold.notes: Privacy hero for the Teams demo. The card, the personal cell and the medical aside must not appear in any CRM field. On a Friday call 'on Monday' is 2026-11-09 and 'by Wednesday' is 2026-11-11.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Hi Dana, it's Aisha from Contoso Woodgrove. Can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Loud and clear, Aisha. Good to see you, even if it's through a screen.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Likewise. I have to say, I love the Seahawks banner on the wall behind you. Is that new?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ha, that's been up for years. I grew up in Seattle, so I'm a huge Seahawks fan, and the banner is basically required.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Did you catch the game this past weekend?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I did, and my nerves did not thank me. The defense held on in the fourth quarter, but those last few minutes were a lot.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Those are the wins you remember. Before we dig in, you mentioned you'd be out for a stretch in December?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, for about three weeks from the first of December. My analyst, Alex Kim, will be your day-to-day contact while I'm out.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know. I hope everything is okay.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's a planned knee surgery, nothing serious, but my surgeon wants me off my feet for a while.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: I'm glad it's planned. Take all the time you need. Let's talk shop, then. You mentioned wanting to add a mid-cap value sleeve to the plan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. We're thinking about the Contoso Mid Cap Value Fund, Class R6, to diversify the large-cap core allocation. I'd like to understand how it would sit alongside what we already own.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: That's a natural fit. Class R6 is the lowest-cost way to own it, built for institutional plans like yours. Mid-cap value tends to behave differently from large-cap core, which is where the diversification comes from.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good. And I need to see the fees side by side before I bring anything to the trustees.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Understood. I'll put together a fee comparison for the Mid Cap Value Fund, Class R6 and send it to you on Monday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect. Oh, and I want to register our two trustees for your institutional forum in Chicago next month. Can we do that now?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Absolutely, I have the registration form open on my side. Do you have a card handy for the attendance fee?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it's my corporate card. The number is 4111 1111 1111 1111.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Got it, thank you. I'll send you the forum confirmation by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great. And if anything urgent comes up while I'm out, text me on my personal cell, 206 555 0188.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Will do. Take care of yourself, Dana, and enjoy the time off.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks, Aisha. Talk soon, and go Hawks.
